messages:
Maria: Quick handoff — stepping out for a ~45m lunch bridge. Leaving a short watchlist and action items below. @Omar @Priya pls keep an eye on canary and queues.

Maria: What changed
- Rolled gw-service 3.2.1 to staging ~11:05. Enabled config flag enable_kv_cache=true for canary.
- Small batching tweak pushed earlier by Ken (may affect latency).

Maria: What to watch
- Canary results for gw-service (11:30 scheduled job).
- p99 latency for model-x on staging (was ~360ms -> now ~420-470ms). Escalate if >500ms.
- Embedder consumer lag (if >30s notify infra).
- Error rate for gw-service (>0.5% alert).

Maria: Action items
- If consumer lag >30s: run `scripts/restart-embedder.sh` or `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/embedder`.
- If canary fails or p99 >500ms: roll routing to model-x-quantized fallback and ping @Laura.
- If error rate spikes: revert new config flag and open a quick rollback PR.

Omar: noted, watching canary and model-x p99. I'll post updates here.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary job for gw-service at 11:30 UTC.

Priya: quick Q — link to perf dashboard?
Maria: https://redwood.internal/observability/perf/gw-service (use timeframe last 30m).

Ken: FYI I pushed the batching config earlier — looks like it could be the latency source. I'll revert in 10m if canary is flaky.

Laura: If revert doesn't help, prepare fallback routing to model-x-quantized. I can own the routing PR.

Omar: preparing fallback PR now so it's quick to apply if needed. Also seeing a slight token usage spike on staging (monitoring).

Priya: running `make consumer-lag` to check embedder queues. Will restart if lag > 30s.

Priya: consumer lag at 42s, restarting embedder now.

Priya: restart done, lag dropping.

oncall-bot: Canary job completed: success. :white_check_mark:

Omar: Canary passed but p99 still ~420ms. Ken, can you proceed with the revert?

Ken: Reverting batching change now, monitoring logs. Command: `git revert c3f2b4 && kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/gw-service`.

Ken: Revert applied, watching metrics.

Omar: p99 down to 340ms after revert — looking stable. :thumbsup:

Priya: embedder lag cleared and stays <5s.

Laura: I'll draft a short incident note if this recurs; for now looks contained.

Maria: Back at ~12:05. Thanks team — main follow-ups for next oncall: confirm no recurrence over next 2 hours, check canary history, and decide if batching tweak needs a staged rollout with smaller change.

Maria: Closing handoff.
